baselineKind: purpose-built 0.1.1 client with the release updater; not a historical 0.1.0 upgrade
sourceScope: The validation client is an isolated copy of the 0.2.0 runtime source with only AppVersion.Current lowered to 0.1.1. Historical 0.1.0 has no updater.

checks.name: read the real published GitHub Unity manifest
installed the actual dedicated 0.1.1 validation client
validation client loads the isolated lesson and skin
validation-client-prepare exits normally without runtime errors
runtime identifies itself as the dedicated 0.1.1 client
opening settings does not manufacture an available update
real GitHub check offers the published target version
package downloaded by the actual client matches published GitHub SHA256 and byte count
actual successful download leaves no partial package
checking and downloading do not change saved course or appearance bytes
clicking Install makes the app save and exit itself normally; QA sent no close message
online-update-client exits normally without runtime errors
actual updater records its pending handoff before restart
the install action saves the complete original lesson and skin before process exit
the real downloaded installer starts a new Player at the same isolated installed path
actual app-to-installer-to-app handoff preserves the exact isolated PROFILEDIR
newly restarted app creates a real confirmed installation receipt and consumes pending state
actual GitHub installation deploys the released DLL and matching installed marker
actual updater generated an installer log inside its isolated update cache
real installer verified old process exit before replacement
automatically restarted released app closes normally
confirmed automatic restart preserves every saved learning and skin byte
released app restores the same learning position and startup preference
released app restores the same named cart, photo and drawing
installed runtime About page reports the released version
a second real GitHub check from the released app reports UpToDate
released-client exits normally without runtime errors
entire online update and repeat check preserve checkpoint, preferences, photo and drawing bytes
native uninstall clears only the online QA copy and its stable AppId registration
native uninstall leaves the isolated learning profile and receipts available for review
default student learning/profile data remains unchanged
